title: Reviewer 1 comment 4 full-image primary-object evaluation
status: Locally fixed before new full-image inference or scoring, not public preregistration
design: Paired retrospective extension of the previously untouched 42-object holdout. This new analysis does not create a fresh untouched holdout.
cohort: All 42 actually materialized cases in the archived r5 input manifest, including its documented pre-inference source substitutions. No selection by new predictions or scores.

inference.configuration: Exact archived r5 CLI command, changing only image path and output path. Frozen automatic decomposition and primary root mode.
inference.input: Complete archived normalized source_full.png copied to anonymous input paths. No ground-truth box, mask, category, object identity, target point or expected profile is supplied.
inference.target_policy: The released primary-object selection policy chooses the output autonomously. No scoring-time selection of the root closest to the reference.
inference.model_policy: Existing frozen checkpoints, prompt bank and retrieval assets. No fitting, threshold search, prompt adjustment, category-specific intervention or outcome-based retry.
inference.attempts: One completed attempt per image. Interrupted/infrastructure-failed attempts are recorded; any mechanical recovery must preserve commands and parameters and be disclosed.
inference.environment_control: First archived cropped input rerun before the full-image run; compare pixel maps and ordered identity/semantic records with historical output. A discrepancy triggers documentation and a paired same-environment cropped rerun, never parameter tuning.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Macro Group F1 at mask IoU 0.25 over all 42 targets. Compare full-image outputs with archived cropped outputs translated into full-image coordinates, using the same full reference masks.
evaluation.prediction_policy: All exported Groups/Parts of the autonomously selected primary object enter the applicable released scoring rule. No ground-truth-based spatial clipping, category filtering, root reselection or restriction to successful detections.
evaluation.primary_scope: Target-specific primary-object pipeline evaluation, not all-object scene detection average precision. Selecting another object is a task error for the originally fixed target.
evaluation.matching: Released PACO evaluator Hungarian maximum total mask-IoU matching followed by thresholding. Released body inclusion and semantic normalization rules are unchanged and only used during scoring.
evaluation.coordinate_control: Reproduce historical crop-space Group F1 mean 0.395109915134312 and verify all available historical case metrics. Compare cropped and full reference masks and report any truncation discrepancy before interpreting paired scores.
secondary_endpoints: automatic root mask IoU and bbox IoU
target root overlap success at IoU 0.25 and 0.50
evaluation.failure_policy: All 42 cases remain in denominators. Missing/invalid output gives zero discovery, overlap and semantic success; count and provenance are reported. No successful-only headline mean.
evaluation.inference_boundary: The contrast measures combined target discovery, context/scale, root construction and downstream grouping effects from removing the annotation-derived crop. It is not a causal isolation of a detector alone.

statistics.unit: Paired target/source image. Confirm unique image IDs; use image-cluster resampling if multiple targets share one image.
statistics.interval: Paired percentile 95% confidence intervals. Primary comparison full-image minus cropped. Secondary intervals descriptive and pointwise, no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim.

reporting: Report the actual performance change regardless of sign. Replace earlier unmeasured-full-image wording after independent audit. Preserve original holdout results and distinguish this retrospective extension. Main text gives compact principal result and boundary; SI gives protocol, counts, metrics and paired intervals.
